# `<dev/log.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Client interface to the log service (logsvc).

Each client owns one pipe to logsvc and writes records into it without blocking. Then logsvc stamps every record with the time, a sequence number and the id of the session it came from, and keeps the most recent ones. A reader asks for records after a sequence number through a second pipe in the other direction.

```c
#include <dev/log.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="log_max_sessions"></a>`LOG_MAX_SESSIONS` | `15` | Most sessions logsvc keeps: one doorbell bit and one death bit each. |
| <a id="log_msg_max"></a>`LOG_MSG_MAX` | `512` | Longest message in a record in bytes. |
| <a id="log_source_max"></a>`LOG_SOURCE_MAX` | `8` | Bytes in a source tag. |
| <a id="log_pipe_size"></a>`LOG_PIPE_SIZE` | `65536u` | Ring size of a writer's pipe. |
| <a id="log_reader_pipe_size"></a>`LOG_READER_PIPE_SIZE` | `PIPE_SIZE_DEFAULT` | Ring size of a reader's pipe. |
| <a id="log_history_size"></a>`LOG_HISTORY_SIZE` | `65536u` | Bytes of history logsvc keeps. |
| <a id="log_crash_size"></a>`LOG_CRASH_SIZE` | `8192u` | Bytes of crash history logsvc keeps apart so debug output cannot evict it. |
| <a id="log_crash_msg_max"></a>`LOG_CRASH_MSG_MAX` | `200` | Longest message a LOG_CRASH request can carry. |
| <a id="log_wire_size"></a>`LOG_WIRE_SIZE(len)` |  | Bytes a client record takes in its pipe: header and message, padded to 4. |
| <a id="log_entry_size"></a>`LOG_ENTRY_SIZE(len)` |  | Bytes a stored or delivered record takes: header and message, padded to 8. |
| <a id="log_attach"></a>`LOG_ATTACH` | `1` | Open a session. The page comes from the client's CreatePipe(). For a writer, logsvc reads the pipe; for a reader, logsvc writes it. |
| <a id="log_event"></a>`LOG_EVENT` | `2` | Give logsvc the pipe's event. [LogIndexRequest](#logindexrequest); grants the event. Session handle. |
| <a id="log_close"></a>`LOG_CLOSE` | `4` | End a session. [LogIndexRequest](#logindexrequest). Session handle. |
| <a id="log_read"></a>`LOG_READ` | `5` | Reader: choose what to receive. [LogReadRequest](#logreadrequest). Session handle. |
| <a id="log_setlevel"></a>`LOG_SETLEVEL` | `6` | Set one source's minimum level, or the console mirror level. [LogLevelRequest](#loglevelrequest). A session handle may set the level of its own source tag only. The console level, which has an all-zero source, needs the admin handle. |
| <a id="log_stats"></a>`LOG_STATS` | `7` | Read counters. [LogIndexRequest](#logindexrequest); replies [LogStatsReply](#logstatsreply). Any handle. |
| <a id="log_crash"></a>`LOG_CRASH` | `8` | Store a record in the crash history. [LogCrashRequest](#logcrashrequest). Admin handle only. |
| <a id="log_claim"></a>`LOG_CLAIM` | `9` | Take the admin handle. [LogIndexRequest](#logindexrequest); grants the admin handle. Public handle only. Succeeds once per logsvc: the first caller gets it, and later calls return ERR_BUSY. |
| <a id="log_kind_writer"></a>`LOG_KIND_WRITER` | `1` | Session kind: the client writes records, logsvc reads them. |
| <a id="log_kind_reader"></a>`LOG_KIND_READER` | `2` | Session kind: logsvc writes records, the client reads them. |
| <a id="log_read_follow"></a>`LOG_READ_FOLLOW` | `(1u << 0)` | LOG_READ flag: when caught up, keep the session open and send new records as they come. |

## Structures

### `LogWireHdr` { #logwirehdr }

A record as a client writes it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `uint8_t` | [LogLevel](../util/log.md#loglevel), 0 to 5. |
| `reserved` | `uint8_t` | Zero. |
| `length` | `uint16_t` | Message bytes after the header. |
| `source` | `char` | The client's own tag: a hint, never trusted. |

### `LogEntryHdr` { #logentryhdr }

A record as logsvc stores it and as a reader receives it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `timestamp_us` | `uint64_t` | Microseconds since boot, stamped by logsvc on receipt. |
| `seq` | `uint32_t` | Counts up and wraps; compare with serial arithmetic. |
| `length` | `uint16_t` | Message bytes after the header. |
| `level` | `uint8_t` | [LogLevel](../util/log.md#loglevel), 0 to 5. |
| `client` | `uint8_t` | logsvc's id for the sending session. Trusted. |
| `source` | `char` | The client's tag, as it sent it. |

| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | The command. |
| `index` | `uint32_t` | Session index. |
